actions.heading: Recommended order of work
paragraphs: Keep the model in service, but make no claim of a proven gain over baseline. Then commission a fresh, independently labelled and sealed evaluation set. Start with non-music audio, where the interval of {F031} to {F032} per cent is weakest. Follow with music examples to tighten the recall interval of {F023} to {F024} per cent.

Hold back recipe changes until that material exists. Reusing the inspected results to choose a recipe would remove their value as independent acceptance. For later runs, compile an explicit objective linked to a production plan.

findings_R01_1.heading: What the receipt records
paragraphs: The record covers this single run only. It holds {F001} measured checks against the signed acceptance. The signed plan records {F002}, {F003}, {F004}, {F005}, {F006} and {F007}. These are plan settings, and the receipt does not label them here, so they should not be treated as model performance.

Against baseline, accuracy rose from {F012} to {F011} per cent and precision from {F016} to {F015} per cent. Recall is {F022} per cent, the same as the baseline of {F025} per cent. The gain is therefore confined to accuracy and precision.

findings_R01_2.heading: How certain each stratum is
paragraphs: The reported intervals are wide. Accuracy runs from {F019} to {F020} per cent, and recall from {F023} to {F024} per cent. Precision starts at {F027} per cent. The baselines of {F021} per cent for accuracy and {F029} per cent for precision sit inside these ranges, so the evidence does not separate the model from baseline.

Specificity is {F030} per cent but with an interval from {F031} to {F032} per cent, the widest of all. The width suggests a small evaluation sample, though the receipt does not state sample sizes. Compute was modest: {F008} minutes on GPU {F009}, with a peak of {F010} GB.

risks.heading: What cannot yet be said
paragraphs: Three things cannot be said from this record. First, general performance outside the measured strata. Only an independently designed evaluation would establish it. Second, independent final acceptance after any further recipe selection. The current results have been inspected, so only fresh sealed, independently labelled material would support it. Third, complete lineage from objective to production, because no new production plan is linked to this historical run.
The values {F002} to {F007} are recorded plan settings, not measured results. Reviewers should keep them separate from the performance figures.

summary: The staged-audio music identification model is recorded as in service, and serving remains a separate operation. The retained receipt holds {F001} measured checks. These results should not be read as proof of improvement. Every interval is wide and each baseline figure that differs lies inside its interval. The widest uncertainty is on non-music audio, at {F031} to {F032} per cent. The next step should be better evidence, in the form of a fresh sealed evaluation set, rather than another tuning round.
